items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: Me and my brother here, Nelson Joseph, Kaiser. And the first Kaiser by the name of Louis Joseph. Always Louis Dumaine's band.

ctx.x: Louis Dumaine, there's three of them. Me and my brother here, Nelson Joseph, Kaiser. And the first Kaiser by the name of Louis Joseph. Always Louis Dumaine's band.
Well, it was Kaiser's, was that his second name or how did they call it?
Well, his first name is Willie, his right name is Willie Joseph. Willie Joseph, yes.
